identity.title: Guardian Gods of the City of Water: Latias and Latios (manga)

leadText: (Japanese: の の ラティアスとラティオス Guardian Gods of the City of Water: Latias and Latios) is the adaptation of Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias. Like other manga adaptations of the Pokémon movies, the manga first appeared in the July 2002 issue of CoroCoro. The manga was written by Toshio Tanigami.
plainText:
(Japanese: の の ラティアスとラティオス Guardian Gods of the City of Water: Latias and Latios) is the adaptation of Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias. Like other manga adaptations of the Pokémon movies, the manga first appeared in the July 2002 issue of CoroCoro. The manga was written by Toshio Tanigami.

==Publications==
The manga adaptation of Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias has only ever been published in its original magazine. It has never seen release in a collected volume anywhere in the world.
